time_convention: t = frame / fps, frame 0 at t = 0
units: pixels (image coordinates, x right, y down) and seconds; no metric scale given
description: Top-down (nadir) drone view of a straight two-lane road running horizontally across the frame, autumn trees above and below, a dark ditch and a green field lower right. Four road users, all in the upper lane, travel right-to-left (-x) at nearly the same pixel rate (~12 px/frame), one behind the other: silver sedan (lead), dark car, white hatchback, red two-wheeler (last). Tree shade covers the road for x < ~590.

camera.type: aerial, looking straight down, essentially static
camera.drift: slow drift of the background relative to frame 0: dy to about -3 px and dx to about -2 px (left half) / 0 px (right half) by the last frame; < 0.05 px per frame; per-frame values in camera_shift.csv
camera.perspective: negligible: road lines horizontal within 1 px across 1920 px; road edge lines parallel; objects keep constant apparent size (all at the same depth, single scale applies)
camera.motion_compensated_columns: cx_bgref_px / cy_bgref_px in tracks = position minus background shift (frame-0 background coordinates)

silver_sedan.identify: leading vehicle; at frame 0 the leftmost car, centre x~481; light grey body with dark windows; in tree shade the whole time
silver_sedan.reference_point: visible body centre (midpoint of front and rear bumper edges, midpoint of side edges)
silver_sedan.length_px_note: visual 66-67 (frame 0: x 449-515); half-max edge profile median ~65 (see profile_length_px)

dark_car.identify: second vehicle; frame-0 centre x~889; dark body, two white headlights at its left (front) end; long cast shadow up-left while in sunlight; very low contrast once in shade (x<590, from frame ~28)
dark_car.length_px_note: visual 60 (frame 0: x 859-919; frame 20: x 626-685); edge profile in sun 61-64 includes some cast shadow at the front

white_hatchback.identify: third vehicle; frame-0 centre x~1305; bright white body, dark rear window band; enters the shade at frame ~60
white_hatchback.length_px_note: visual 59-60 (frame 0: x 1275-1334; frame 100: x ~79-138); half-max edge profile 54 (sun) to 58 (shade)

cyclist.class: two-wheeler with rider (red/white; bicycle or motorcycle - keeps pace with the cars)
cyclist.direction: -x, upper lane, near the lane centre / slightly lower than the cars
cyclist.identify: last and smallest road user; frame-0 centre x~1682; red and white rider/vehicle with a long dark shadow up-left; enters shade at frame ~91 where it becomes faint
cyclist.reference_point: visible centre of rider+vehicle (rear end - 17 px)
cyclist.length_px_note: visual 28-35 px (frame 0: x 1665-1699 incl. dark front part; ~28 px at frame 70-81); colour mask 20-26 px misses the dark front; uncertain +-4 px

road.identify: straight asphalt road, horizontal across the whole frame
road.upper_lane: y 521-563 (edge-line to centre-line spacing 44.5 px); all four road users use it
road.centre_median: narrow strip between the two centre lines, y 565-571 (line spacing 8 px)

upper_fence.identify: fence/guardrail with vertical posts above the road

lower_fence.identify: fence/guardrail with vertical posts below the road

roadside_verges.identify: grass/gravel strips with small regularly spaced markers

tree_shade_on_road.identify: shadow of the trees covering the road
tree_shade_on_road.extent: road in shade for x < ~560-620 (oblique boundary), sunlit to the right

trees_upper.identify: autumn tree belt above the road, y < ~470, with a dark diagonal gap/path near x 520-900

trees_lower_left.identify: autumn trees below the road, left part (x < ~900)

ditch.identify: dark diagonal water ditch/channel below the road, from about (880,690) down-left to (1100,1080) region

field_lower_right.identify: green field, lower right quadrant (x > ~1100, y > ~700)

events.motion: all four road users are already moving at frame 0 and keep moving leftward until they leave the frame; no starts, stops, overtakes, contacts or direction changes
events.entries: nothing enters the frame during the clip
